name: plex.v3
refuses: bad magic, version != 3, hsize misaligned or < directory end, truncated header/directory, cell type not in {1,4,8}, arity 0, length != rows*arity*type, unaligned or sub-hsize offset, missing/duplicate KIND_PIR section, declared span short or past EOF, trailing bytes beyond the span (rc=3)
doc: .plex v3 archive — the kernel depacks the container itself: validates header + every 32B directory row, selects the unique KIND_PIR span, hands a bounded-EOF stream to ir_sloop via plexleft (ADR-0006 ingest, gate 22).
